mcq.s: Which one of the following is NOT true for the Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission (JNNURM)? It was:
o: to upgrade the quality of life in Indian cities
mcq.x: JNNURM was launched on 3 December 2005 as a 7-year mission (2005-12, later extended), not a 10-year programme, to improve urban infrastructure and quality of life.

mcq.s: Which one of the following is the best strategy for environment-friendly sustainable development in Indian agriculture?
o: Expansion of cultivable land, increased use of superphosphate, urea and effective biocides
Wider popularisation of high-yielding crop varieties, better irrigation facilities and more intensive cultivation
Mixed cropping, organic manures, nitrogen-fixing plants and pest-resistant crop varieties
Improved farm implements and machinery, use of biogas and expansion of cultivable land
mcq.x: Mixed cropping, organic manures, nitrogen-fixing plants and pest-resistant varieties keep soil healthy and cut chemical inputs, the core of eco-friendly sustainable farming.

mcq.s: Unplanned urbanisation and industrialisation are harmful:
mcq.x: Over-urbanisation and industrialisation upset balanced development, degrade the environment and ecology, and destroy habitats and biodiversity.

mcq.s: In which of the following ecosystems is the species diversity relatively the highest?
mcq.x: Biodiversity increases towards the equator; tropical rain forests hold the greatest species diversity of all terrestrial ecosystems.

mcq.s: As an ecosystem, wetlands are useful for which of the following?
o: Removing heavy metals through absorption by plants
Reducing siltation of rivers by retaining sediments
mcq.x: Wetlands recycle nutrients, filter pollutants such as heavy metals through their plants, and trap sediments, acting as the 'kidneys' of the landscape.

mcq.s: Methane is emitted from which of the following?
o: Both paddy fields and termite mounds
